# Font Family

::: tip 实现进度 90% · 已完成
活示例对标 Amis Font Family：`font-sans` / `serif` / `mono` 落在同一元素的 `font-family`，字栈与 Amis helper 硬编码一致。独立样例 + 组合。本页与 Amis 一样没有 `m:` / `pc:`，不支持状态前缀。
:::

用哪套字。三条类都是 Amis helper 硬编码栈，不是 `--font-sans` token。page / `.vamis-root` 默认走 `--fonts-base-family`（与 Amis 组件栈相同）；写了 `font-sans` 才换成 `ui-sans-serif, system-ui, …`。Vamis schema `className` 打在外层 `div.vamis-node`；本页用 HTML 岛把类打在内层 `<p>` 上。

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `font-sans` | `font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji";` |
| `font-serif` | `font-family: ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif;` |
| `font-mono` | `font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace;` |

## font-sans

Amis helper 硬编码栈：`ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"`。page / `.vamis-root` 默认走 `--fonts-base-family`（与 Amis 组件栈相同）；只有写了 `font-sans` 才换成这条。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <p class="font-sans">The quick brown fox · 系统黑体 font-sans</p>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <p class="font-sans">The quick brown fox · 系统黑体 font-sans</p>
  </div>
```

## font-serif

Amis 衬线栈：`ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif`。中文落到后面的 serif。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <p class="font-serif">The quick brown fox · font-serif</p>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <p class="font-serif">The quick brown fox · font-serif</p>
  </div>
```

## font-mono

Amis 等宽栈：`ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace`。不是 `var(--font-mono)`。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <p class="font-mono">const x = 1; font-mono</p>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
    <p class="font-mono">const x = 1; font-mono</p>
  </div>
```

## 组合

同一组：`font-sans`、`font-serif`、`font-mono`。

```schema
type: tpl
inline: false
tpl: |
  <div class="space-y-2">
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
      <p class="font-sans">sans</p>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
      <p class="font-serif">serif</p>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
      <p class="font-mono">mono</p>
    </div>
  </div>
```

```schema: scope="body"
type: code
language: html
value: |-
  <div class="space-y-2">
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
      <p class="font-sans">sans</p>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
      <p class="font-serif">serif</p>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-gray-200 p-sm rounded-md">
      <p class="font-mono">mono</p>
    </div>
  </div>
```

## 响应式设计

本页与 Amis 一样：没有 `m:` / `pc:` 设备前缀。

## 状态前缀

本页与 Amis 一样：不支持[「状态前缀」](/style/state)。helper 源码写了 `// hover ?` 但没有做。

其它 helper 见 [辅助类-响应式设计](/style/responsive-design)、[辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
